name: whatsapp-im
description: A WeChat-like IM built as a pnpm monorepo

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r --parallel --filter '!@im/shared' run dev
scripts.dev:server: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @im/server run dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @im/web run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r --filter '!@im/shared' run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r --filter '!@im/shared' run typecheck
